reviews.name: A. Z.
reviews.text: I lost 2 kg in 1 week of using this app.  BitePal helped me to learn more about calorie intake and the best meals for my body, without giving up ice cream or other foods that I like. 10/10! Totally recommend this app, and for quicker results, do some exercise!

reviews.name: Aistė K.
reviews.text: I love love LOVE this app - the friendly atmosphere, the encouraging texts from your little racoon buddy, the genuinely educational and non-discriminatory eating suggestions. It's truely AMAZING!!

reviews.name: K.
reviews.text: Has helped me so much through my calorie deficit. This app has made me feel like losing weight was a game and I enjoyed counting my calories.

reviews.name: A. Z.
reviews.text: I lost 2 kg in 1 week of using this app. I did exercises on the side, but I didn't feel like it was hard or difficult to stay consistent because of this app. BitePal helped me learn more about calorie intake and the best meals for my body, without giving up ice cream or other foods that I like. 10/10! Totally recommend this app, and for quicker results, do some exercise!

reviews.name: N.
reviews.text: I love love love this app. It’s sooooo helpful, it really helped with my relationship with food, as well as with my calorie deficit! I also love how the team is constantly seeking feedback and following it up with improvements. Good job!

reviews.name: S.
reviews.text: Really great app. I have already lost about 5 kg in 3 months. I have also checked its accuracy and it is usually off by 20–30 kcal, which really isn't bad.

reviews.name: L.
reviews.text: I absolutely love this app, the character is so cute, it’s always kind to you no matter what you eat and encourages you to want to make changes on your own, finds the good in all things and has helped me with my relationship with food. Cannot recommend it enough.
